Title: Verify creating System User with non-existent Employee ID is rejected
Preconditions: Employee ID 99999 does not exist in PIM
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create System User with empNumber 99999.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. User is not created due to invalid employee reference.

Title: Verify newly created Job Title is available for assignment in PIM
Preconditions: Admin and PIM modules are accessible
Steps: 1. Create a new Job Title in Admin. 2. Fetch the list of allowed Job Titles when adding/editing PIM Job Details.
Expected Result: The newly created Job Title appears in the PIM selection list.

Title: Verify System User disabled state prevents login
Preconditions: System User exists and is enabled
Steps: 1. Admin updates the System User status to Disabled. 2. Attempt to login with that user's credentials.
Expected Result: Login is rejected with an account disabled message.
